rules: cloudflared and the dashboard execute only on bare-cedar-fog
Cloudflare carries public ingress but never owns the dashboard's application or Leader identity decision
Google OAuth remains the sole Leader-seal requirement at the application boundary
the one tunnel-specific token resides only at ~/.config/cloudflared/bare-cedar-fog-561-group.token with directory 0700 and file 0600
cert.pem and account-wide locally managed tunnel credentials are not admitted by this service
